Lisa · Listen & Shadow 05

Craggy Range, First Visit — the trip, who you are, the tasting, bringing it back
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · THE TRIP
👤 The Winery
When are you flying, and for how long?
언제 가시고 며칠 계세요?
fly — 비행기로 가다
💬 Lisa
I'm flying out next month and back after four days.
다음 달에 가서 나흘 있다가 돌아옵니다.
fly out — 출국하다 · back — 돌아오다
같은 패턴으로 — I'm flying out on the fifth and back on the ninth. · We're heading out Friday and back Sunday.
💬 Lisa
We're meeting the export manager on the first day, then the winemaker.
첫날 수출 담당자를 만나고, 그다음 와인메이커를 만나요.
export manager — 수출 담당자 · winemaker — 와인메이커
같은 패턴으로 — We're meeting the buyer first, then the team. · I'm seeing the supplier Monday, then the factory.
💬 Lisa
My part is to walk them through the Korean market.
제 역할은 한국 시장 상황을 전하는 거예요.
my part — 내 역할 · walk someone through ~ — ~를 설명하다
같은 패턴으로 — My part is to handle the tasting notes. · My part is the pricing.
💬 Lisa
It's my first time meeting them in person.
직접 만나는 건 이번이 처음이에요.
in person — 직접, 대면으로
같은 패턴으로 — It's my first time visiting the estate. · It's my first time presenting in English.
PART 2 · WHO YOU ARE
👤 The Winery
They know Kumyang. They don't know you. Who are you?
금양은 알지만 당신은 모릅니다. 누구세요?
know of ~ — ~를 알다
💬 Lisa
I'm at Kumyang — I look after the New Zealand portfolio.
금양에서 뉴질랜드 포트폴리오를 맡고 있습니다.
look after ~ — 맡아서 관리하다 · portfolio — 취급 라인
같은 패턴으로 — I look after the French range. · She looks after key accounts.
💬 Lisa
Before this, I worked as a sommelier in Singapore.
그 전엔 싱가포르에서 소믈리에로 일했어요.
before this — 그 전엔 · sommelier — 소믈리에
같은 패턴으로 — Before this, I worked in a kitchen. · Before that, I was on the floor.
💬 Lisa
I was on the floor before I was on this side of the table.
이쪽으로 오기 전엔 현장에 있었어요.
on the floor — (레스토랑) 홀에서 · this side of the table — 파는 쪽
같은 패턴으로 — I was a server before I was a buyer. · He was a cook before he was a chef.
PART 3 · AT THE TASTING
👤 The Winery
We're pouring Le Sol. What do you think?
Le Sol 따라드릴게요. 어떠세요?
pour — 따르다
💬 Lisa
On the nose, it's pepper and dark fruit first.
향은 후추와 검은 과일이 먼저 오네요.
on the nose — 향은 · dark fruit — 검은 과실
같은 패턴으로 — On the nose, it's citrus. · On the palate, it's much softer.
💬 Lisa
It's firm on the palate, with a long finish.
입에선 단단하고, 마무리가 길어요.
palate — 입안, 미각 · finish — 여운, 마무리
같은 패턴으로 — It's round on the palate. · It's crisp, with a short finish.
💬 Lisa
Compared to the 2022, this one is much more closed.
2022년과 비교하면 이건 훨씬 닫혀 있어요.
closed — (아직) 열리지 않은
같은 패턴으로 — Compared to last year, it's riper. · Compared to the north, this side is cooler.
💬 Lisa
How do you decide when to pick?
언제 수확할지는 어떻게 정하세요?
pick — 수확하다
같은 패턴으로 — How do you decide when to bottle? · How do you decide what to blend?
💬 Lisa
For Korea, I'd say this one has the best shot — it works with the food.
한국에선 이게 제일 가능성 있어요 — 음식과 잘 맞아서요.
have the best shot — 가능성이 제일 높다
같은 패턴으로 — For Korea, the whites have the best shot. · That one has the best shot at the list.
PART 4 · BRINGING IT BACK
👤 The Winery
You're not here to sign anything, are you?
이번엔 계약하러 오신 게 아니죠?
sign — 계약하다
💬 Lisa
I'm here to learn, not to sign.
이번엔 배우러 온 거지 계약하러 온 건 아니에요.
be here to ~ — ~하러 오다
같은 패턴으로 — I'm here to listen, not to sell. · She's here to help, not to decide.
💬 Lisa
Is there any room on Le Sol?
Le Sol을 조금 더 받을 수 있을까요?
room — 여유, 여지
같은 패턴으로 — Is there any room on the price? · Is there any room in the schedule?
💬 Lisa
I'd have to take that back to Seoul.
그건 서울에 가져가서 얘기해야 해요.
take ~ back to ~ — ~에 가져가서 논의하다
같은 패턴으로 — I'd have to take that back to my manager. · Let me take that back to the team.
💬 Lisa
Let me follow up on the allocation when I'm back.
돌아가서 물량 건은 다시 연락드릴게요.
follow up on ~ — ~ 건을 다시 챙기다
같은 패턴으로 — Let me follow up on the samples. · I'll follow up next week.
녹음 20/20
